content.what_it_is: Third-party MATLAB File Exchange utility (bundled in FUNWAVE-TVD tools/plot_googlemap) that draws a Google Static Maps image under the current axes. Author Zohar Bar-Yehuda, version history 1.1 (25/08/2011) through 1.8 (25/04/2016, Hannes Diethelm resize support) documented @L96-119; usage/properties (Axis, Height/Width max 640, Scale 1-2, Resize, MapType, Alpha, ShowLabels, Style, Language, Marker, Refresh, AutoAxis, FigureResizeUpdate, APIKey) documented @L5-72. Main function plot_google_map(varargin) @L1: persistent apiKey/useTemp @L120 — loads api_key.mat if present @L122-127, probes temp-folder write access via tempname/fopen @L131-146; defaults @L152-166 (height/width 640, scale=2, resize=1, maptype='roadmap', alpha 1, autoRefresh/figureResizeUpdate/autoAxis/showLabels 1); property parsing switch @L169-215 including 'apikey' persisting the key to api_key.mat next to the function file @L202-208; clamps height/width to 640 @L216-221. Stores varargin in axes UserData.gmap_params for refresh callbacks @L224-230. Sanity-checks axis limits for WGS84 (@L232-236 warning if |axis|>500 etc.), enforces EPSG:900913 latitude [-85,85] and longitude wrap @L239-256, world map default [-200 200 -85 85] for empty figures @L258-262. autoAxis block @L266-322: converts axis corners to Spherical Mercator meters (latLonToMeters), compares x/y extents against the axes pixel aspect ratio and symmetrically enlarges the smaller span (capped at 85 deg lat / 180 deg lon) so the map is not stretched, re-clamping latitude @L316-320 and applying axis before download @L321. Deletes previous 'gmap'-tagged children, preserving any ButtonDownFcn @L326-339. Zoom level: minRes from extent/pixels @L342-345, tileSize=256, initialResolution=2*pi*6378137/tileSize (comment 156543.03392804062) @L344-345, zoomlevel=floor(log2(initialResolution/minRes)) @L346 clamped 0..19 @L349-354. Builds Static Maps URL from center lat/lon @L357-410: preamble http://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/staticmap @L361, zoom/scale/size/maptype strings @L363-365, key @L366-370, markers joined with %7C @L371-378, showLabels=0 appends style 'feature:all|element:labels|visibility:off' @L380-385, language @L387-391, jpg for satellite/hybrid vs png (needs colormap->RGB conversion) @L393-400, sensor=false @L402, style @L404-408. Downloads with urlwrite to tempdir or cwd @L413-420; on failure warns with the URL for debugging and returns empties @L421-430. imread @L433, Mcolor*255 @L434, deletes temp file @L436; converts indexed PNG to truecolor via cur_map(M+1) reshape @L448-456, optional imresize bilinear @L458-460. Reconstructs pixel meshgrid in EPSG:900913: curResolution=initialResolution/2^zoomlevel/scale/resize @L468, xVec/yVec around center pixel @L469-471, converts back to WGS84 with metersToLatLon @L475, resamples onto a uniform lat/lon grid (linspace @L480-481) with myTurboInterp2 @L487 so it can be shown with image() instead of pcolor (rationale comments @L439-444). Plot mode (nargout<=1) @L489-536: image() with preserved caxis @L492-494, YDir normal, tag 'gmap', AlphaData @L495-497, invisible 2x2 dummy image extending pan/zoom range @L500-501, uistack bottom @L503, restores original axis @L504, walks up parents to the figure @L510-514, installs zoom/pan ActionPostCallback=@update_google_map when autoRefresh @L516-524, figure ResizeFcn=@update_google_map_fig if unset @L529-532, restores ButtonDownFcn @L535; else returns lonVect/latVect/uniImag @L536-539. Helper subfunctions: metersToLatLon @L543-548 and latLonToMeters @L550-555 (Spherical Mercator with originShift=2*pi*6378137/2, comment 20037508.342789244; y=log(tan((90+lat)*pi/360))/(pi/180)); myTurboInterp2 @L558-602 nearest-neighbour resampling assuming rectilinear grids (per-axis position search L570-600, ZI=Z(yiPos,xiPos,:) @L602); update_google_map @L605-617 re-invokes plot_google_map with stored gmap_params from the zoom/pan event axes; update_google_map_fig @L621-640 re-invokes for every axes containing a 'gmap' object, appending its Axis handle to params if missing.

verbatim_spans.text: % Plots a google map on the current axes using the Google Static Maps API
initialResolution = 2 * pi * 6378137 / tileSize; % 156543.03392804062 for tileSize 256 pixels

unresolved: HTTP (not HTTPS) endpoint @L361 and '&sensor=false' @L402 are deprecated Google Static Maps usages (2016-era); whether the API still serves them is external to this file

persistent apiKey initialized check 'if isnumeric(apiKey)' @L121 relies on uninitialized persistent being [] (numeric) — after 'apikey' property sets a string it is never reloaded from file in the same session; cross-line L120-127 vs L202-208
longitude clamps @L247-256 set curAxis(1)=0 when >180 and curAxis(2)=0 when <-180 — collapses rather than wraps the axis; intent unresolved
world-map default sets curAxis=[-200 200 -85 85] @L261 exceeding the just-enforced [-180,180] bounds
myTurboInterp2 y-direction search assumes descending Y (YI(idx) <= Y(1) && YI(idx) >= Y(end) @L586) matching yVec built height:-1:1 @L471 — works only for that orientation
uniImag initialized zeros(uniHeight,uniWidth,3) double @L484 then overwritten by uint8 gather @L487 — the preallocation is dead; image() receives uint8

update_google_map_fig appends 'Axis' to params @L634-637 but plot_google_map parses the lowercase 'axis' case @L172 via lower() @L171 — consistent, though params stored pre-lowercasing; relies on strcmpi @L635
